import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources/zero-sum-followup.pdf'),'-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/zero-sum-followup.txt'],input=z.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
print('LENGTH',len(z.stdout));print(z.stdout[:22000]);print('MATOMAKI END', (p/'sources/matomaki.txt').read_text()[18000:])
